purpose: Reusable non-authorizing evidence-validation components for selecting and validating current applicable evidence without creating the underlying authority state.

components.name: Current Applicable Verification Record Selector

inputs.current_binding: non-secret KV/SKAP current-verification binding projected by the authoritative verification domain
inputs.candidate_records: zero or more already-admitted owner-authorization plus admission-receipt pairs evaluated only inside the selector
inputs.operation_context: task/COSV/purpose/context against which current applicability is evaluated

outputs.verification_provenance: existing non-secret KV/SKAP verification provenance projection for the exactly selected candidate
outputs.selected_record_ref: opaque reference derived from exact selected source digests; raw owner authorization and receipt are not returned
outputs.selection_evidence: non-secret exact digest bindings and decision metadata

components.authority_owner: KV/SKAP Vault for user-verification state; TV/TVC for admitted credential-receipt semantics
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: Deterministic for identical inputs. Retry only with a newly observed authoritative current binding or a changed candidate set; never fall back to latest-by-time selection.

components.name: Repository Ledger Genesis Readback

inputs.organization: organization whose refs/stegverse/organization-ledger holds the repository subtree; also selects the fetch source https://github.com/<organization>/.github.git
inputs.repository: repository whose chain is kept in repository-ledger/<organization>/<repository> of that ref
inputs.expected_organization_ledger_head: 40-hex organization-ledger commit the repository's genesis manifest is bound to
inputs.owning_existing_goal: existing Goal Task the six fields name

outputs.disposition: ALLOW, or FAIL_CLOSED carrying failure_code, failed_predicate, required_evidence_or_repair, retry_entrypoint, owning_existing_goal and next_attempt
outputs.repository_chain_evidence: on ALLOW: genesis and head receipt digests, chain length, and that every receipt verifies and is retained in the organization ledger

components.authority_owner: The organization (runtime reality custody) for the ledger ref; its organization ledger writer for any append. This component only reads.
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: Deterministic for an identical request and fetched head. Re-entered only when a manifest transition visits it again (the existing resident request dispatcher, consumer repository_ledger_genesis_readback); it owns no schedule, loop, clock or retry. The answer for a (request, observed head) pair is retained once.
